title: refactor(objectql): spell the eight ObjectQL facade methods' inferred return types and move five bodies into their facets (.d.ts byte-equal)
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKd8GqhzWbGWABewb5SLGNm)_

domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`engine.ts` 门面上 8 个因返回类型靠推断而留在类上的 `ObjectQL` 方法把返回类型写明在签名上（逐字取自今天的 `.d.ts`）；其中 `getStatus`、`triggerHooks`、`setDatasourceMapping`、`init`、`destroy` 五个再用 codemod 第四遍（#30055 的 `--members`）把方法体搬进各自的 facet 模块，类上只留一行转调；allow-list 删掉这 5 行。
- 为什么改：返回类型写明后，方法体放在哪都不会改变公开类型，门面才能只剩转调（#30054 第二半，第一半是已合并的 #30516）。
- 风险与回滚：没有行为变化；`@objectstack/objectql` 的三个公开 `.d.ts` 改前改后逐字节相同，codemod 的撤销证明逐字节通过。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 里 `init` / `destroy` 的新 stub，再看 `engine-secrets-and-routing.ts` 里搬进来的 `init` 方法体。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members --verify --base 405373c08` 预期 exit 0、“5 moved method(s) … does rebuild the base … byte-for-byte”；`node scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs` 预期 exit 0、56 条具名例外。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。`registerApp`、`registerDriver`、`registerHook` 三个 codemod 拒绝搬，留在类上（见 Acceptance notes）。

Part of #30054 (the `engine.ts` half: all eight return types spelled, five bodies moved; three engine.ts bodies and the eight protocol.ts bodies stay, see Acceptance notes)

Clause-②: no — the published `index.d.ts`, `core.d.ts` and the shared declaration chunk of `@objectstack/objectql` are byte-equal before and after, so no exported member changes.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — an internal refactor of eight method signatures and five method bodies' location; no published type or behaviour changes, and no skill text names them.

## What changes

- **Return types (`engine.ts`).** `registerApp`, `registerHook`, `registerDriver`, `init`, `triggerHooks`, `destroy`, `setDatasourceMapping` and `getStatus` declare their return type, copied from the line the base build printed for each in `dist/util-*.d.ts` (the `ObjectQL` class), re-indented to the file's two spaces. `getStatus` spells `name: "data"` with the printer's double quotes, which the declaration emit keeps.
- **Moves (`--members`).** `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members getStatus,triggerHooks,setDatasourceMapping,init,destroy --write`: `getStatus` and `triggerHooks` go to `engine-hooks-and-functions.ts`, `setDatasourceMapping` and `init` to `engine-secrets-and-routing.ts`, `destroy` to `engine-migration-state.ts`. Each method stays on the class with its docblock and signature as a one-call stub. Nothing generated is edited by hand.
- **Registry.** The five moved members' rows are deleted (the gate refuses a row whose member is already a delegation). The three rows that stay keep card #30054 and say why each body stays.
- **Pin.** `engine.facade-return-types.pin.test.ts` parses `engine.ts` and requires each of the eight methods to carry its exact return type text.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/objectql` patch: the declarations are byte-equal, but the shipped source maps move.

## Tests

- New pin: 9/9 at head. On `origin/main`'s `engine.ts` (restored unstaged, then put back from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty) 8 of 9 fail, one per method.
- Ablation (once, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): `init`'s stub annotation removed, anchor 1 → 0, blob `2fa8f560` → `20c28b40`; the pin goes 1 failed / 8 passed, naming `init`; restored to the `HEAD` blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The facade gate is the pin for the moves: with the five rows deleted it is red on `origin/main` (five members with a body and no row) and green at head.
- `@objectstack/objectql` full suite: 554 files passed, 11,019 tests passed at head `2ea0deb9d` (and the same counts before the branch moved onto `c23eafa88`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` exit 0 at head.

## Acceptance notes

- **Three bodies the `--members` pass will not move.** `registerApp` and `registerDriver`: the pass refuses with "engine-registration.ts: its header is not as the first pass wrote it" (that module's header was edited by hand when `isExternalWriteForbidden` was written there, #30370). `registerHook`: the pass writes the move but its undo proof fails ("undoing the moves out of engine-hooks-and-functions.ts does not rebuild its base (first difference at line 44)", in that module's import block). Each is measured alone and together; the order lands only what is mechanical, so their rows stay with the reason.
- **What #30054 still owes.** `engine.ts`: `registerApp`, `registerDriver`, `registerHook` (types spelled, bodies stay). `protocol.ts`: the eight doors typed by #30516, whose move waits on the protocol codemod's missing facade pass (#30518). The seat decides whether those eleven rows move to #30518 or a sibling card and the card closes, or the card stays open.
- **A spelled type is now the published shape** (as on #30516): a later change to what one of these methods returns edits its signature too, because a wider body return is not refused and the `.d.ts` prints the signature.
- **The branch.** #30516 was squash-merged from this same branch. A force-push to restart it from `main` was refused in this session, so the branch merges `origin/main` over #30516's old commits (the merged tree equals `main` exactly: `git diff origin/main` was empty before this PR's commits), and the PR's commit list shows those old commits. The diff is this PR's seven files only.

## Verification

Head `2ea0deb9d`, base `origin/main` `c23eafa88`.

<details><summary>Declaration-file proof</summary>

- Base: `origin/main` `c23eafa88`'s `engine.ts` and its three facet modules restored into the head tree, `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/objectql...`, `core.d.ts`, `index.d.ts` and `util-DJB5AN6K.d.ts` copied aside (byte-equal to the first base build at `8e5fabe58`, from which the types were copied).
- Head: `pnpm build` in `packages/objectql` (tsup with DTS, then `check-dts-emitted`); `cmp` against the base copies: all three byte-equal (`util-DJB5AN6K.d.ts` sha256 `7f1e928b2f3aceac…`). The same held after the annotation commit alone, before the move.
- The diff of the emitted declarations is empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Codemod proof</summary>

- `--members getStatus,triggerHooks,setDatasourceMapping,init,destroy` plan, then `--write`: output tree sha256 `ebff07ef5c50e416…` both times; "5 moved method(s) … engine.ts 11321 -> 11223 lines; undoing the moves does rebuild the base engine.ts and its modules byte-for-byte once the 7 import binding(s) only moved bodies read are pruned from the base".
- `--members --verify --base 405373c08` (the annotation commit, on this base) exit 0 with the same reading.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head `2ea0deb9d`: 70 derived commands (change set: 7 paths, +262 / -168, under the 3,000 threshold). Each ran with its exit code recorded before any pipe; all 70 exit 0. `--ran` reconciles 70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `node scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs`: "5 facade class(es) in 3 file(s) hold delegations only, 56 named exception(s)", exit 0. Against `origin/main`'s tree (`--root` a detached `c23eafa88` worktree, `--registry` this head's): exit 1, five problems, one per moved member.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` over the five changed source files exit 0 at head.

</details>
